text: šumma awīlum īn mār awīlim uḫtappid, īššu uḫappadū.
english: If a man destroys the eye of a member of the awīlum-class, his eye shall be destroyed. [inferred: Code of Hammurabi §196, lex talionis]

text: šum-ma a-wi-lum a-wi-lam ú-ub-bi-ir-ma ne-er-tam e-li-šu id-di-ma la uk-ti-in-šu mu-ub-bi-ir-šu id-da-ak
english: If a man accuses another man and charges him with murder but does not prove it, his accuser shall be put to death. [inferred: Code of Hammurabi §1, false accusation of murder]
